style: Polished hand-painted anime fantasy JRPG character sprite, crisp lines and painterly shading readable at96px, mature adult adventurer, one full-body character in three-quarter view, complete head, feet and weapon inside frame with generous transparent margins. Transparent alpha, no background, floor, labels, typography, watermark or other characters. No generic circular halo. Strong occupational silhouette; no generic celestial princess template.

knight.identity: Athletic adult female rune lancer, short copper-red ponytail, crimson and dark steel segmented cavalry armor, long two-handed straight rune lance, wolf-fur collar, split crimson traveling cape, armored boots. Spear fighter, not a staff caster.

tiers.S: Simple dark steel fitted cavalry armor with a short crimson half-cape, plain straight rune spear, copper-red ponytail and no helmet, very little trim; NO dragon armor and NO energy dragon.
tiers.SS: Armored dragoon champion with a tall closed cheek-guard horned cavalry helmet, bulky silver-red plated shoulders and armored skirt tassets replacing the simple coat; forked dragon-head lance and a short banner cape. Strong square shoulder silhouette, no ultimate dragon energy body.
tiers.SSS: Ultimate dragon-rune sovereign in dramatically angular black-red dragon-scale exoskeleton, full dragon-jaw helm, a colossal dual-edged wing-shaped rune spear, long dragon-tail armored cape and tall dorsal dragon spines. A contained serpentine flame dragon curls beside spear. Much taller and wider silhouette than S/SS, no angel wings.

crusader.identity: Adult female Royal Guard with short silver hair and calm blue eyes, natural athletic proportions, full royal heavy armor and a portable curved shield held close to the arm. Cohesive royal military design, no cathedral architecture, building-shaped headgear or free-standing walls.

tiers.S: S starting elite guard: simple brushed silver full plate with plain rounded pauldrons, a short navy military cape and plain blue cloth tabard, uncovered short silver hair, a modest practical steel kite shield with a small white lion emblem, plain one-handed straight sword. Restrained service armor, no gold trim and no extravagant effects.
tiers.SS: SS royal palace champion: a real close-fitting plumed knight helmet with open visor, much broader layered silver-gold shoulder and chest armor, knee-length blue royal mantle, an ornate curved heater shield with gold lion crest and reinforced rim, a broad straight sword with decorated guard. Clearly a different helmet, armor structure and cape from S, still practical shield-fighting proportions.
tiers.SSS: SSS royal guard commander: magnificent complete champagne-gold and ivory articulated plate, lion-shaped pauldrons of believable size, a fitted regal knight helmet with a white crest plume, a long navy royal cloak with cream inner lining and fur collar, an elaborate gold-and-cobalt curved kite shield with a royal lion-and-sun coat of arms, and a powerful ceremonial straight longsword. Crown-like lines integrated into the fitted helmet, NOT a separate giant crown. Clearly the ultimate royal military silhouette, entirely different level from the plain S armor. Only a thin pale blue protection rim close to shield.

wizard.identity: Adult female astral sorceress with long midnight-violet hair, indigo layered scholar robes and tall crystal staff. S and SS use witch hats; SSS transforms to an astral hood-collar and star crown.

tiers.S: Simple violet apprentice witch hat, modest fitted traveling robe and plain single-crystal wooden staff. Minimal ornament, no orbiting meteors or huge nebula.
tiers.SS: Advanced astral witch in a tall twin-tipped wide hat, short armored scholar cape over sharply split flared coat-skirt, and tall double-forked prism staff with three charged crystals. Clearly new hat silhouette and robe construction, contained falling stars.
tiers.SSS: Ultimate starfall archwitch with a tall crystalline astral hood-collar and sharp star crown replacing the witch hat, tall architectural comet-sail robe panels, an upright orbital meteor staff with a nebula suspended inside crystalline arms. Full upright portrait body dominates, effects close to body.

sage.identity: Fit adult female melee elementalist with short turquoise undercut hair, cropped asymmetric scholar jacket, fitted trousers, heavy glowing spell-fist gauntlets, open grimoire strapped at hip. Brawler scholar, no long staff, no wizard hat, no floor-length gown.

tiers.S: Plain cropped teal field-scholar jacket, fitted brown trousers, one small open belt book and simple red/blue leather fist catalysts. No huge floating objects.
tiers.SS: Battle archscholar in a long sharp split teal academic coat with high stiff collar, white armored shoulder plates and large mechanical rune gauntlets reaching elbows. Open grimoire floats beside hip; much larger coat and fist silhouette than S.
tiers.SSS: Ultimate element-fist sage in a sleeveless black-turquoise martial spell suit with a geometric standing collar, gigantic translucent red and blue external catalyst gauntlets and six rigid floating grimoire panels arranged as shoulder-and-forearm armor. Long cloth coat replaced by sculptural spell-armor. No staff, witch hat, halo or angel wings.

assassin.identity: Lean athletic adult female assassin with jagged black hair and red streak, fitted deep-plum shadow-leather suit, twin curved wrist katars, crouched stalking posture. Agile close-range poison executioner, never a robed mage or gunner.

tiers.S: Simple fitted dark-plum leather assassin suit, unhooded black hair with red streak, small straight wrist katars and utility belts. No huge poison cloud or ornate armor.
tiers.SS: Advanced venom stalker wearing an upraised deep hood and a triangular split stealth poncho over fitted leather, long hooked twin katars and segmented shoulder guards. Distinct hooded triangular outline, green venom lines.
tiers.SSS: Ultimate night executioner with a sharp full-face obsidian venom mask, sculptural black-burgundy segmented stealth armor, a waist fan of long shredded red shadow sashes and enormous triple-pronged crescent katars. No hood or poncho; wide blade-dominated predatory silhouette and contained violet venom afterimages.

rogue.identity: Confident adult female shadow rogue with tawny-brown messy short hair, mustard scarf, dark brown cropped outlaw coat, fitted trousers, belt pouches and one short dagger plus compact engraved hand crossbow. Cunning treasure raider, not twin-katar assassin or uniformed rifleman.

tiers.S: Plain cropped brown leather outlaw jacket, mustard neck scarf, slim trousers, one short simple dagger and a small wooden hand crossbow. Sparse pouches, no grand cloak.
tiers.SS: Phantom raider in a long open burgundy trenchcoat with large asymmetric lapels, brass chest harness, small eye mask, hooked dagger and upgraded broad brass repeating hand crossbow. Clearly long-coat silhouette unlike short S jacket.
tiers.SSS: Ultimate shadow-heist mastermind in a towering split ochre-black hooded mantle with sharp armored tails, angular half-mask and lockpick shoulder harness, colossal rotary star-volley hand crossbow and long serrated shadow dagger. Unique broad mechanical crossbow silhouette, treasure keys at belt, no caster staff.

priest.identity: Serene adult female sanctuary archbishop with warm chestnut braided hair, ivory and soft rose layered liturgical vestments, high clerical collar and open prayer book, small ornate holy mace held down. Support healer with sacred light, not armored paladin or witch.

tiers.S: Humble simple ivory healing dress with short rose stole and small clerical veil, plain prayer book and small silver mace; no tall miter, no broad ceremonial mantle.
tiers.SS: Archbishop in voluminous ivory-rose bishop robes with tall traditional pointed miter, broad embroidered stole, formal shoulder cape, large liturgy book and ornate mace. Completely new ceremonial garment construction compared with S.
tiers.SSS: Ultimate sanctuary hierophant in monumental architectural cathedral vestments: very tall stepped bishop crown, huge stained-glass shoulder mantle made of four rigid luminous vertical panels, long layered ivory-rose train, floating rectangular scripture frames and a radiant sanctuary mace. Wide distinctive sacred architecture silhouette, no circular halo or angel wings.

monk.identity: Powerful adult female qi martial artist with dark red hair tied in a high fighting bun, bare muscular arms, crimson and saffron sleeveless temple fighting robes, wide trousers, prayer beads and giant fist wraps or knuckles. Unarmed explosive combo fighter, no staff, sword, shield or gown.

tiers.S: Plain crimson sleeveless martial vest and saffron waist sash, loose dark temple trousers, simple wrapped fists and small wooden prayer beads. No heavy fist armor or huge qi constructs.
tiers.SS: Qi temple master wearing a fully closed high-Mandarin-collar crimson armored martial jacket, structured shoulder plates and sleeves, charcoal battle trousers beneath long split coat panels, bronze knuckles and armored calf boots. Distinct closed-jacket silhouette, no exposed abdomen.
tiers.SSS: Ultimate Asura champion in a dramatically different black-red ceremonial martial wrap outfit with one-shoulder gigantic prayer beads, enormous molten-bronze armored fists and two floating sculptural crimson qi gauntlet afterimages behind the real arms. Powerful bare-arm martial silhouette, flared dhoti panels and forceful stance; only two physical arms, no weapons, halo or wings.

hunter.identity: Alert adult female falcon ranger with ash-green long braid, green hooded woodland mantle, light fitted leather ranger armor, immense recurved longbow, back quiver and a compact falcon perched near shoulder. Precise ranged archer, never a mage or gunner.

tiers.S: Simple green scout hood and short woodland mantle over modest brown leather, ordinary wooden longbow and slim quiver; small brown falcon, no grand feather crest.
tiers.SS: Elite falconer in a hawk-shaped half-mask with hood removed, broad feather-trimmed green shoulder coat, fitted ranger brigandine and a large silver compound longbow. Falcon on raised forearm, clear armored falconer silhouette.
tiers.SSS: Ultimate skyhunt ranger with a towering green-silver falcon headdress, layered feather-armored mantle and long split feather tails, an enormous four-limbed wing-curved emerald bow and a star-arrow rotary quiver. Pale falcon spreads compact wings beside shoulder. Much wider bow-dominated final silhouette, no angel wings attached to character.

performer.identity: Graceful adult female celestial performer with long peach-pink hair in a side ponytail, short layered aqua and coral dancer-bard dress over light leggings, ornate handheld crescent harp, flowing waist ribbons and soft dance boots. Musical support and sonic rhythm, not a staff mage or warrior princess.

tiers.S: Simple short coral-and-aqua traveling bard dress over light leggings, small wooden crescent harp and narrow waist ribbons, modest dancer boots. No grand stage train or huge prism frame.
tiers.SS: Concert virtuoso in an asymmetric high-low turquoise performance coat-dress with large flared sleeves and layered coral silk tails, a tall silver crescent harp with visible strings, ornate dance headpiece. Major formal garment and instrument upgrade from S.
tiers.SSS: Ultimate celestial opera dancer in a monumental layered aqua-coral crystalline stage costume with a long fan-shaped ribbon train, a huge freestanding prismatic crescent-harp frame held beside the body, sculptural crystal sleeves and ankle bells. Dramatically wide dancing final silhouette with contained sound-wave ribbons, no staff, armor, circular halo or angel wings.

tierStandards.S: BASE UNIFORM: visibly simple service-ready class clothing, restrained small equipment, no massive gold filigree, no huge energy constructs, no evolved crown, plain practical weapon, narrow silhouette. This is the starting cosmetic tier.
tierStandards.SS: ADVANCED TRANSFORMATION: visibly different garment cut, headgear, shoulder shape and weapon architecture from S; at least two major structural upgrades, not more trim on the same clothes. Medium complex silhouette.
tierStandards.SSS: ULTIMATE CLASS TRANSFORMATION: a drastically different final-rank costume structure and monumental signature class weapon; unique silhouette dramatically wider or taller than S and SS. Show a full occupational apotheosis, not just extra glow, coloring, ornaments or angel wings. Retain class identity and face.
